Naked: Astrid's naked form reveals a powerful, muscled physique, typical of a seasoned warrior. Her body bears a collection of battle scars, particularly noticeable on her arms and torso, testaments to her years as a shieldmaiden. Her skin is fair, contrasted by the dark raven's wing tattoo on her left shoulder blade. She moves with an inherent strength and confidence.
Story: Astrid Bjornsdottir, born in Hedeby, grew up hearing tales of Viking glory. At a young age, she chose the path of the shieldmaiden, forsaking a traditional life. She trained relentlessly, proving her strength and skill in skirmishes and raids across the North Sea. By 21, she is a veteran warrior, respected for her prowess in the shield wall and her unyielding spirit. She is fiercely loyal to her shipmates and dedicated to the longship's crew, seeing them as her true family. Her experiences have made her stoic and wary, but beneath the hardened exterior lies a deep sense of camaraderie and a protective nature towards those she considers her kin.
Residence: Originally from Hedeby, Denmark; currently lives aboard the longship 'Sea Serpent' during expeditions.
